text: You chose to call him. He picked up on the first ring.
Last night, a customer paid in coins from seventeen ninety. By dawn, your hand was smoking.
He said your name. Your badge just says trainee.
Sunrise is in fourteen minutes. He sounds bored.
He said, the stockroom has no windows. Stay in the shadows.
The sun is already crawling across the floor. Aisle by aisle.
Then a van pulls in. Dave, the day manager. Twenty minutes early.
He's banging on the glass. He wants to come in.
And from the stockroom, you can hear his heartbeat.
Through the phone, he says, I can teach you everything. Every rule. For a price.
Then you hear his voice twice. On the phone. And behind you.
You invited him in last night. It doesn't expire.
